computed_fit_value_meaning: minimum-norm pseudoinverse of a rank-zero training design; not an experimentally identified zero gain
static_flash_prediction: structural zero for any gain in this two-site correlator
motion_prediction_scope: B0 numerical zero-gain scores are algorithmic diagnostics only; not calibrated motion predictions and not evidence of a biological zero response
conclusion: Static flashes cannot identify the baseline correlator's voltage gain. Its inability to represent signed stationary flash responses remains a separate structural restriction.
